SVC_UART.name: UCG Module Service (UART)
SVC_UART.description: Madoka runtime control tunnel. Advertised in ADV 128-bit service list. App name: serviceUART.

CHR_UART_RX.name: UART RX (notify)
CHR_UART_RX.description: Controller → phone. Subscribe CCCD 0x0001. Each notification is one ≤20-byte chunk (index + optional length + payload).

CHR_UART_TX.name: UART TX (write cmd)
CHR_UART_TX.description: Phone → controller. Write Without Response only. Chunked 20-byte UART frames wrapping function ID + TLV.

structure.description: First chunk only: byte count of (length field + application payload)
Application PDU: uint16 BE functionId (bit 14 = SET) followed by TLV [id][len][value…]

SVC_UUG.name: UUG Service (BLE OTA)
SVC_UUG.description: UEI UAPI channel for UE878 radio-module firmware. Not used by the JS thermostat protocol.

CHR_UUG_RX.name: UUG RX (notify)
CHR_UUG_RX.description: OTA responses from the BLE module

CHR_UUG_TX.name: UUG TX (write cmd)
CHR_UUG_TX.description: OTA commands to the BLE module (Write Without Response)

CHR_UUG_EVT.name: UUG event (notify)
CHR_UUG_EVT.description: Present on real units; unused by Madoka Assistant JS
